Olivia Ops: Heads-up: were finalizing logistics for the 3/23 virtual roundtable. Need signoff on registration fields, Zoom interpretation, recording exports, and the post-event replay flow.
Sam Growth: quick ask  are we gating the replay? last time we saw better lead quality but fewer views.
Priya Marketing: propose soft gate (company + role + consent). email replay to registrants automatically. lower friction, still good signal.
Marta Sales: sales prefer company + role + opt-in. please also push a HubSpot flag for enterprise SDRs.
Olivia Ops: registration fields: full name, email, company, role, opt-in checkbox (GDPR copy), optional "use case" short text. Hidden UTM fields for channel.
Jamal Eng-Infra: Zoom settings recommendations:
```
- Enable Interpretation (English + Mandarin)
- Record separate audio tracks per participant
- Record active speaker + gallery view
- Auto-transcribe English (VTT)
- Cloud recording + host local backup
- Retain cloud for 30 days
```
Olivia Ops: note: interpretation channel creates alt audio but Zoom VTT is single-language. we'll need downstream transcriptions for Mandarin.
Priya Marketing: post-event plan: 1) pull cloud files, 2) split language tracks, 3) send each to transcribers (vendor) for native SRT, 4) assemble localized reels.
Sam Growth: Zapier -> HubSpot mapping: map registration -> create/update contact, set property "roundtable_2026" = registered, add to list "Roundtable - registrants", store use_case in contact property. If attended -> set "roundtable_2026"=attended.
Olivia Ops: exact Zap pseudo: ```Trigger: Typeform new entry -> Action1: Create/Update Contact -> Action2: Add to List -> Action3: Create Note with use_case```
Marta Sales: routing: if company_size >= 100 AND role in ["VP","Head","Director"] -> assign to Enterprise SDR queue. Tag contacts as "priority_lead" in HubSpot.
Ava PM: clip workflow: we need three 45-90s clips. editors: vendor @ClipHouse. timeline: raws to S3 within 24h, edits back in 72h. I'll create Notion tasks and S3 path.
Jamal Eng-Infra: filename convention: `rd-roundtable-YYYYMMDD-session-<lang>-<track>.mp4`. also export separate audio tracks named `rd-roundtable-YYYYMMDD-speaker-<name>-<lang>.wav`.
Priya Marketing: email cadence: attendees get thank-you + resources immediately. non-attendees get short edited replay + 30s highlight 24h later. subject A/B test on replay send: "Roundtable replay + TL;DR" vs "Watch: 3 takeaways from the roundtable".
Sam Growth: testing plan: split 50/50 on non-attendees, track CTR and demo requests.
Olivia Ops: day-of checklist (timeline): mic checks 30m prior, interpreter joins 20m prior, host starts local recording at 5m, enable interpretation, post a brief privacy/recording note at start.
Priya Marketing: registration confirmation copy: "Thanks for registering! We'll email the Zoom link and a replay. By registering you agree to receive related content." short and explicit.
Jamal Eng-Infra: post-event steps: 1) download cloud recording, 2) split tracks, 3) run vendor transcriptions per language, 4) generate language-specific SRTs, 5) upload to S3 and note assets in Notion with timestamps for clip boundaries.
Marta Sales: SDR playbook: if priority_lead=true & attended=true -> create sequence in HubSpot flagged "sales_outreach_high". include clip links in outreach.
Ava PM: social plan: live announcement on LinkedIn + X during event, day+2 post with 30s clips. editors need brand overlays and captions (EN+ZH).
Olivia Ops: owners recap: Registration & Zap: Olivia. HubSpot props & lists: Priya. Recording & exports: Jamal. Clip edits & social copy: Ava. SDR routing: Marta. Replay send cadence & A/B: Sam.
ZoomBot: Reminder: scheduled cloud recording starts when host joins. Use `/start_recording` to override.
Sam Growth: I'll validate the Zap flow in staging tomorrow AM and post screenshots. thanks everyone.
Priya Marketing: will review registration copy in the doc now, tagging Olivia for final proof. :rocket:
